title: Skin Tattooing As A Novel Approach For DNA Vaccine Delivery
protocol: Transform the eukaryotic plasmid DNA encoding EGFP (pCX-EGFP) into DH5α E.coli competent cells.
Culture and harvest the DH5α E.coli cells.
Purify the pDNA according to the Qiagen EndoFree Plasmid Purification Handbook.
Filter pDNA solution through a 0.22 μm PVDF sterile filter.
Store filtered pDNA at -20 °C until use.
Connect the handheld unit and the control pedal to the power supply unit per the manufacturer's instructions.
Set the needle oscillation frequency to approximately 100 Hz.
Sterilize the needle array before use.
Install the needle array into the handheld unit.
Loosely attach the plastic grip.
Adjust the needle depth to an appropriate setting by moving the plastic grip up or down.
Tighten the plastic grip when the needle depth is properly set.
Choose a firm, flat, and fleshy area of the skin for tattooing treatment.
Anesthetize the balb/c mouse with a mixture of ketamine (90 mg/kg) and xylazine (5 mg/kg).
Check the animal's reflexes by pinching its foot to confirm proper anesthesia.
Trim down the hair at the animal's hindlegs slowly and carefully using an electrical trimmer.
Remove residual shorter hair from the planned tattooing site and surrounding area with a disposable safety razor.
Use compressed air to remove stray cut hairs from the skin.
Calculate the dose and volume of DNA solution for application according to an established immunization protocol.
Apply the DNA solution by pipetting directly onto the tattooing site.
Alternatively, load the DNA solution into the plastic grip by pipetting, suspending it between the needle and tip of the plastic grip.
Start the needle oscillation and place the needle array with light pressure on the animal's skin at the tattooing site.
Move the oscillating needle gently and slowly in a linear fashion to deliver plasmid DNA over the entire tattooing area.
Maintain a 90-degree angle between the needle and the skin to avoid lacerations to the skin.
Continue the needle movement for approximately 1 minute.
Stop the tattooing process.
Apply a thin layer of topical analgesic on the tattooing site using a clean cotton swab.
Observe animals the next day for signs of pain or distress.
Reapply analgesic cream if signs persist.
Euthanize the mouse by CO2 narcosis 48 hours after tattooing treatment.
Dissect the skin at the tattooing site.
Fix the tissue in 4% paraformaldehyde at 4 °C overnight.
Rinse the tissue with 70% ethanol.
Transfer the tissue into 1X PBS for imaging.
Examine the whole tissue using a confocal microscope to check for EGFP signals.
